review_candidates.title: Cybersecurity Senior Engineer II

As the Cybersecurity Senior Engineer, you will be responsible for overseeing the technical execution and delivery of cybersecurity solutions to clients. This includes managing the implementation of these solutions, conducting site visits to maintain the cybersecurity solution, providing cybersecurity training, and consulting on cybersecurity matters
